text: 对待很好很好的朋友
en: Towards very, very good friends

text: 喝酒诉苦玩游戏
en: Drink, pour out troubles, and play games

text: 对待普通朋友
en: Towards ordinary friends

text: 谈理想谈行业谈国际视野
en: Discuss ideals, the industry, and global horizons

text: 对待女朋友
en: Towards a girlfriend

text: 像松鼠抓住了松子，抱着，警惕着，藏起来
en: Like a squirrel that has grabbed a pine nut, hugging it, staying alert, hiding it away

text: 对待追求自己但是不喜欢的人女生
en: Towards girls who pursue you but whom you don't like

text: 我很忙，我很累，我睡了
en: I'm busy, I'm tired, I'm going to sleep

text: 对待老妈
en: Towards Mum

text: 不打电话，只接电话，半个小时全是嗯嗯嗯
en: Never call, only answer calls; the whole half hour is just 'mm, mm, mm'

text: 对待老爸
en: Towards Dad

text: 不打电话，只发微信，不够，多少，1500，发你了，谢谢老爸
en: Never call, only message on WeChat: not enough, how much, 1500, sent to you, thanks Dad

text: 对待客户
en: Towards clients

text: 我很专业，聊行业，聊竞对，聊公司高层，聊商业模式
en: I'm very professional — discuss the industry, discuss rivals, discuss company senior management, discuss business models

text: 对于大学里的男生来说，你了解真实的他的一个方法就是问他的室友呀....我的室友嫖过chang，约过炮，和十几个女生保持亲密关系，然而追女生的时候却扮演人畜无害的角色。
en: For boys at university, one way to find out what he's really like is to ask his roommate.... My roommate has paid for chang, hooked up, and kept intimate relations with over a dozen girls, yet when pursuing girls he plays the part of a completely harmless, innocent chap.

text: 然而那个女生并没有问过我们就和他在一起了...真是个悲伤的故事
en: Yet that girl got together with him without ever asking us... what a sad story

text: 1，打篮球并不是为了耍酷，也不是为了表现给路过的女生看，只是皮球入网或者帽掉对手的那一刻，真的很爽。
en: 1. Playing basketball isn't to show off, nor to perform for girls passing by; it's just that the moment the ball swishes through the net or you block your opponent, it really feels great.

text: 2，男生也是感性的动物，他们也会被一首歌，一部电影，一件琐事感动，但他们死要面子，大多数时刻都不愿表现出来。
en: 2. Boys are also sentimental creatures; they too can be moved by a song, a film, or a trivial matter, but they're stubborn about saving face and most of the time unwilling to show it.

text: 3，排除极少数天性贾宝玉的异类，如果男生单独在你面前流露出脆弱的一面，至少在那一刻，他是信任你的。
en: 3. Setting aside the very few exceptions with a Baoyu Jia nature, if a boy reveals his vulnerable side to you alone, at least in that moment he trusts you.

text: 4，男生回复你微信长篇大论滔滔不绝，不一定是对你有好感，可能他们只是想炫耀自己的逻辑能力和姿势水平。
en: 4. When a boy replies to your WeChat with endless, long-winded messages, it doesn't necessarily mean he fancies you; maybe he just wants to show off his powers of logic and his 'posture level'.

text: 5，男生一副心不在焉神游太空的样子并不是对你不满，他说随便无所谓也不是对你敷衍，可能只是今天他支持的球队比赛输了。
en: 5. When a boy looks absent-minded, off in space, it's not that he's displeased with you; when he says 'whatever, doesn't matter', it's not that he's fobbing you off — maybe the team he supports just lost their match today.

text: 6，如果男生总是不回你消息，不要自我安慰他现在多么多么的忙，其实答案很简单，你没有那么重要而已。
en: 6. If a boy never replies to your messages, don't comfort yourself thinking how, how busy he must be; the answer is actually simple — you just aren't that important to him.

text: 7，不论之前你们的关系好到怎样的无话不谈，当你有男朋友以后，他都会主动保持一段距离。
en: 7. No matter how close you were before, to the point of telling each other everything, once you have a boyfriend he will take the initiative to keep his distance.

text: 如果他还是和你亲密无间的话，要么情商太低，要么别有所图。
en: If he's still as close to you as ever, then either his emotional intelligence is too low, or he has an ulterior motive.

text: 当然，你们是亲兄妹当我没说。
en: Of course, if you're biological brother and sister, pretend I didn't say that.

text: 8，男生在大多数发呆的时候，并不是在思考人和宇宙的关系，可能是在进行一些中二的幻想：比如拥有隐身的超能力，走进女浴室。
en: 8. Most of the time when a boy is spacing out, he's not pondering the relationship between man and the universe; he's probably having some chuunibyou fantasy: like having the superpower of invisibility and walking into the girls' showers.

text: 9，男生对女生好，一种是对一个人的好，一种是对所有人好。
en: 9. When a boy is good to a girl, there are two kinds: being good to one person, and being good to everyone.

text: 前者是喜欢，后者是习惯。
en: The former is liking; the latter is habit.

text: 所以，一个男生对你好并不能绝对的说明爱你，这个得看情况。
en: So, a boy being good to you doesn't absolutely mean he loves you; it depends on the situation.

text: 10，男生和你关系暧昧，不一定是喜欢你，因为真心喜欢一个人，是受不了暧昧的，所以，可能只是他暂时没有更好的人选。
en: 10. If a boy keeps things ambiguous with you, it doesn't necessarily mean he likes you, because someone who genuinely likes a person can't stand ambiguity — so it may just be that he has no better option for the time being.

text: 11，情侣之间，女生和男生说任何事情他都不介意的时候，通常是不在意你。
en: 11. Between couples, when the boy doesn't mind whatever the girl says, it usually means he doesn't care about you.

text: 不介意你的男同事和你搭讪，不介意你不联系他，不介意你遇到事情不告诉他，说明他也不介意，有一天没有你。
en: He doesn't mind your male colleagues chatting you up, doesn't mind you not contacting him, doesn't mind you not telling him when something happens — which shows he also wouldn't mind a day without you.

text: 12，男生与男生之间没有过不去的坎，生活里的小摩擦，打一架喝一顿酒第二天醒来就忘了，如果还不能忘，就再喝一顿。
en: 12. Between boys there's no grudge that can't be overcome; a small friction in life, a fight and a drink, and they forget by the next morning — if they still can't forget, just drink another round.

text: 13，一个看起来绅士聪明善解人意温柔懂事会各种套路撩妹的男生，往往背后经历过一个伤得他遍地磷伤死去活来的女生。
en: 13. A boy who seems like a gentleman — clever, understanding, gentle, sensible, and skilled in every trick to flirt with girls — often has behind him a girl who hurt him so badly she left him battered and broken all over.

text: 14，在男人的世界里，尊严是很重要的。
en: 14. In a man's world, dignity is very important.

text: 他真心喜欢你的时候，可以追你捧你，为你花钱省吃俭用苦着自己，但是当你瞧不起他鄙视他，把他的尊严践踏在地的时候，他会决然不回头的离开。
en: When he genuinely likes you, he can chase you, praise you, spend money on you, tighten his own belt and suffer hardship for your sake; but when you look down on him, despise him, and trample his dignity into the ground, he will leave resolutely, never looking back.

text: 15，把这个回答看到这里的女生，此刻心里多半在想着某个男生。
en: 15. Girls who have read this answer all the way to here are, at this moment, mostly thinking of a certain boy.

text: 16，千人千面，不同年纪，不同性格的男人，会有着不同的一面。
en: 16. A thousand men, a thousand faces; men of different ages and different personalities will show different sides of themselves.

text: 说到底，男人也是人，他们也会有孤独和脆弱，惶恐与不安，只是在生活和社会的压力面前，他们学会了隐藏。
en: At the end of the day, men are human too; they too have loneliness and fragility, apprehension and unease — it's just that in the face of life's and society's pressures, they've learned to hide it.

text: 这是为了更好的保护自己，也是为了给心爱的人留一块柔软。
en: This is to better protect themselves, and also to keep a soft spot for the one they love.

text: 比较久了，来更新一下。
en: It's been a while; time for an update.

text: 妹子们看见评论区的各位知乎大佬了吗？
en: Girls, have you seen all the Zhihu big shots in the comments?

text: 要我说，不管这个人说的啥，别管，看他如何做。
en: If you ask me, whatever this person says, don't mind it — look at what he does.

text: 听一半留一半。
en: Take half of it, leave half.

text: 我是女生，已婚。
en: I'm female, married.

text: 强答一波。
en: I'll jump in with an answer.

text: 我认为男生大部分都是非常理性的。
en: I think most boys are very rational.

text: 他去追你有部分原因是认为你的条件适合当时的他，大概率能拿得下。
en: Part of the reason he pursued you is that he thought your qualities suited the version of himself at the time, and that he could very likely win you over.

text: 并且拿下后都会见机行事。
en: And once he's won you over, he'll act according to the situation.

text: 原始欲望和一见钟情很少的，大家都是经过教育的人。
en: Raw desire and love at first sight are rare; everyone here is an educated person.

text: 至于，如何避免遇见渣男，除了要看父母遗传，还要看他本身的家庭是怎样的相处模式。
en: As for how to avoid meeting a scumbag, besides looking at what he inherited from his parents, you must also see what the dynamics of his own family are like.

text: 了解他父母为人就可以了。
en: Just get to know what his parents are like as people.

text: 女人恋爱记住一句话，买猪要看圈。
en: Women, remember one thing when in love: when buying a pig, you must look at the pen.

text: 仗义、大方、磊落的父母教育不出渣滓，就算万中无一的，他有点小奸小坏，也有人给你撑腰了对不对？
en: Upright, generous, and open-hearted parents won't raise scum; even if, against all odds, he's a little scheming or naughty, there'll still be someone to back you up, right?

text: 那种刚一接触就能闻到浓浓的小市民狡黠和市井气息的家庭，敬而远之，否则被吃了连骨头都剩不下。
en: Families from whom, the moment you make contact, you can smell the thick pettiness of small-town folk and a vulgar, market-place air — keep your distance, or you'll be eaten up without a single bone left.

text: 这不是让你朝钱看，而是让你思考因果。
en: This isn't telling you to be money-minded, but to think about cause and effect.

text: 就连农民家庭也分无数种的。
en: Even peasant families come in countless varieties.

text: 村里大户，父母本分阳光善良会过日子和酗酒嚼舌头根子的完全是一天一地的区别。
en: Among a village's prominent families, parents who are dutiful, sunny, kind and know how to live well are a world apart from those who get drunk and wag their tongues behind others' backs.
———————————— Update separator line.

text: 一觉醒来，发现答案毁誉参半。
en: Waking up, I found the answer had met with both praise and criticism.

text: 我玩知乎，纯粹就是玩，赞这个东西有也好，没也可，并不重要，所以我犯不上故意抛出个错误、耸动观点骗赞，所以毒鸡汤这词，恕我拒不领受。
en: I use Zhihu purely for fun; upvotes — having them or not having them is fine, it doesn't matter — so I have no reason to deliberately put out a wrong or sensational view just to trick upvotes. Therefore the term 'toxic chicken soup' is one I'm afraid I must respectfully decline to accept.

text: 很多朋友是大学校门都没出，涉世不深，对于爱情的理解很单薄，想不到日后有什么可能和爱人家人相处的机会，但是逢年过节你不跟爱人回家吗？
en: Many friends haven't even stepped out of the university gate, haven't seen much of the world, and have a thin understanding of love; they can't imagine the future chances of getting along with a partner and family. But don't you go home with your partner for the holidays?

text: 对方父母病倒在床你不照顾吗？
en: When the other's parents fall ill in bed, won't you care for them?

text: 孩子全程自己照看不求人？
en: Will you look after the children entirely by yourself, asking no one for help?

text: 你见过真正的人渣家庭是怎么对儿媳妇的？
en: Have you ever seen how a truly rotten family treats its daughter-in-law?

text: ——“谁让你跟他的？
en: —— Who said you could be with him?

text: ”“让你嫁到我们家还委屈你了？
en: ”“ Do you think marrying into our family wronged you?

text: 更有甚者，教育儿子怎么驯服自己媳妇的也大有人在。
en: What's more, there are plenty of people who teach their sons how to tame their own wives.

text: 有些父母，尤其是当婆婆的，其心可诛。
en: Some parents, especially mothers-in-law, have truly condemnable hearts.

text: 我当然希望每个人找到的爱人都是顶天立地，不受家庭半点影响的真汉子，只要你和他所在家庭发生一点点摩擦，他一句话就能摆平自己父母，当你愤愤不平地抱怨一句“哎呀，咱妈怎么能那么说话”，他坚定不移地站你这边，至于能不能，没人敢咬死字眼拍板儿，你若有妲己那两下子，还用得着看别人怎么说？
en: Of course I hope the partner everyone finds is a towering, true man, utterly uninfluenced by his family in the slightest — so that at the slightest friction between you and his family, he can smooth things over with his parents in a single sentence; when you grumble in frustration, 'Oh, how could our mum say that', he stands unwaveringly by you. As for whether he really can — no one dares nail it down and make a final ruling. If you had Da Ji's tricks, would you still need to listen to what others say?

text: 所以至少是存疑这两个字，还是有的吧？
en: So at the very least, the words 'open to question' still apply, don't they?

text: 我在知乎答题不太考虑政治正确，就当成对自己家老妹传授人生经验，如同你问我穷人家的孩子有没有资格学哲学，我会告诉你没有，因为热爱智慧的结果可能是就不了业（你是百里挑一的人才，一路名校读下来留校任教算我没说，但你又何必来抬这个杠？
en: When I answer questions on Zhihu I don't think much about political correctness; I treat it as passing on life experience to my own little sister. It's like if you asked me whether a poor family's child is qualified to study philosophy — I'd tell you no, because a love of wisdom might well leave you unable to find a job (if you're a one-in-a-hundred talent who went through top schools and stayed on to teach, then count me out of that; but why would you come and argue this point with me?

text: 就为了显你了不起所以把同样贫寒的平庸后辈往火坑推？
en: Just to show how impressive you are, you'd push a similarly impoverished, mediocre younger person into the fire?

text: ），我希望有缘跟我提问的人，都能得到一种无风险、不赌博的easy模式答案，我没有恶意，更不是瞧不起人。
en: ), I hope that those who happen to ask me will all get a risk-free, no-gambling, easy-mode answer. I mean no harm, and certainly don't look down on anyone.

text: 另外答案里也举例子了，评论回复也举例子了，不清楚大家是选择性忽视了还是怎么。
en: Besides, I already gave examples in the answer, and gave examples in the comment replies; I don't know if everyone just selectively ignored them or what.

text: 小市民不是经济实力的小，而是品质的小，我能夸朴实农民子弟值得一嫁，我会在意那些普通中国式家长的小瑕疵吗？
en: A petty townsman's smallness isn't about financial means but about character. If I can praise plain peasant lads as worth marrying, would I fuss over the minor faults of ordinary, typically Chinese parents?

text: 嘴碎点，偶尔反智一点，不叫坏；根本不会推己及人，只考虑自己和自家儿子的感受，拿儿媳妇当外人防着，将一切打上有用没用标签并区别对待的才叫坏。
en: Being a bit gossipy, occasionally a little anti-intellectual — that's not bad. What's truly bad is never being able to put yourself in others' shoes, only considering your own and your son's feelings, treating the daughter-in-law as an outsider to guard against, and labelling everything useful or useless and treating people differently accordingly.

text: 如果伤到了许多从原生家庭脱离的朋友，在这里向大家道个歉，我无意于鄙视谁，我也没有那个资格。
en: If I've hurt many friends who've escaped their family of origin, I'd like to apologise to everyone here; I have no intention of despising anyone, nor do I have the qualification to.

text: 但请大家在理解上面的学习哲学专业的例子的基础上正确理解我的意图。
en: But please, on the basis of understanding the above example about studying philosophy, correctly understand my intention.
————————— Final update.

text: 觉得自己头铁，就去试。
en: If you think you're hard-headed, go and try.

text: 我把评论区一部分现身说法的置顶，不是得意洋洋地显摆“老子说话就这么准”，而是让每个人看到这种可能，然后结合人生经验切实提高自己的分辨能力，俗称“多一个心眼”。
en: I've pinned some first-hand accounts from the comments — not to smugly show off that 'what I said was spot on', but to let everyone see this possibility, and then, drawing on life experience, genuinely improve their own discernment, commonly called 'keeping an extra eye out'.

text: 至于是不是一棍打死，我实在是不想多费口舌了，我从始至终也没说家庭不好的人一定就不能找（什么叫好什么叫不好在评论区有充分讨论）。
en: As for whether this is writing everyone off with one stroke, I really don't want to waste any more words; from start to finish I never said people from bad families absolutely can't be chosen (what counts as good and what as bad has been thoroughly discussed in the comments).

text: 胸口纹条龙的人未必就是社会人，但他纹身的动机你好不好奇？
en: A person with a dragon tattooed on his chest isn't necessarily a gangster, but aren't you curious about why he got the tattoo?

text: 是社会人的可能性大不大？
en: Isn't the likelihood that he's a gangster quite high?

text: 我歧视他了吗？
en: Have I discriminated against him?

text: 你问问胸口纹龙的大哥们能不能接受也纹条龙的女婿？
en: Ask those big brothers with dragons tattooed on their chests whether they could accept a son-in-law who also has a dragon tattooed on his chest.

text: 这不是交朋会友，这是生死捆绑一辈子的事，谁还不审慎些？
en: This isn't about making friends; this is a matter of being bound for life, through life and death — who wouldn't be more cautious?

text: 那些脱离原生家庭并且把自己爱人保护的不错的人，我真心实意敬佩你；最终陷入轮回，遇到了真事恶性渐显的，我也不想鄙视你，个人日子各人过。
en: Those who have broken away from their family of origin and protected their partner rather well — I sincerely admire you. Those who ultimately fell into the cycle and met real evil that gradually revealed itself — I don't want to despise you either; everyone lives their own life.

text: 伏愿每个人都能找到自己的幸福，即便遇到不那么良善的家庭也能和自己爱人一起渡过难关，我这个答案就放这，等你们来打我脸，这比有人哭着说“早该信你的”让我开心，毕竟这个社会如果乱糟糟，家庭伦理崩坏，苦了孩子，也对每个人都不利。
en: I devoutly wish everyone could find their own happiness, and even if they meet a not-so-kind family, get through the hard times together with their beloved. I'll just leave this answer here, waiting for you to slap me in the face — that would make me happier than someone crying and saying 'I should've believed you'. After all, if this society becomes a mess and family ethics collapse, the children suffer, which is bad for everyone.

text: 评论区有人问到底怎么分辨好坏，我这里列举几条日常生活所得，请自行分辨真伪。
en: Someone in the comments asked how exactly to tell good from bad; here I'll list a few things I've learned from daily life — please judge for yourself what's true and false.

text: 1.刚一接触就不拿你当孩子，更像谈生意，至少对你善意有限。
en: 1. The moment you meet, he doesn't treat you like a child but more like a business deal — at the very least, his goodwill towards you is limited.

text: 2.家族成员众多，彼此关系亲密，唯独他家与众人既不走动也不来事的，原因值得弄清楚。
en: 2. A large family whose members are close to one another, yet his household alone neither visits nor keeps in touch with anyone — the reason is worth getting to the bottom of.

text: （也有可能是亲戚太差劲了）
en: (It's also possible the relatives are just awful.)

text: 3.喜欢笑容灿烂，貌似天真地旁敲侧击给你灌输封建女儿经的婆婆，往往婚后丑态毕现，视你为二等公民。
en: 3. A mother-in-law who loves a radiant smile and, seemingly innocent, drops hints to feed you feudal rules for daughters — after marriage her ugly side often shows, and she treats you as a second-class citizen.

text: 4.对底层服务人员颐指气使，特别喜欢在言语上亮肌肉的，势利眼。
en: 4. Those who boss around low-level service staff and especially love to flex their muscles in words are snobs.

text: 如果你的条件没能碾压对方子女，可能会常常听到一些愚蠢却又自以为聪明的“话中话”，教你认清形势。
en: If your qualities don't utterly outclass the other side's children, you may often hear some stupid yet self-perceived-clever 'hidden meanings', teaching you to recognise the situation.

text: 5.如果你父母经济实力、社会地位相对不高，介绍情况时对方本能地作出倨傲微表情（微表情，注意）两家日后必定不合，你父母如果是老实人，可能会被连带着通吃。
en: 5. If your parents' economic strength and social status are relatively low, and the other side instinctively shows a haughty micro-expression when introductions are made (micro-expression — note this), the two families are bound to clash later. If your parents are honest folk, they may be taken advantage of along with you.

text: 6.常常以高知自居（或明说或暗示），一口一个我们家如何如何的，粗暴干涉你们二人生活的可能性极高，关键时刻不管不顾的可能性也高。
en: 6. Those who often regard themselves as highly educated (stated openly or hinted), going on and on about 'our family this, our family that', have a very high chance of crudely interfering in the two of you's life, and also a high chance of abandoning you at the critical moment.

text: 7.你可以试着旁敲侧击地聊怀孕分娩话题，对自然生产绝对强调，认为侧切、剖腹是不可接受，不顾女性疼痛感受的…
en: 7. You can try to sound her out indirectly about pregnancy and childbirth; if she absolutely insists on natural birth, regards episiotomy and caesarean as unacceptable, and disregards the woman's experience of pain…
